entities.summary: Johann Rihosek was an Austrian engineer and locomotive designer. He was born in Maków Podhalański, in Austro-Hungarian Galicia on 5 June 1869. Rihosek attended the middle school at Olmütz and later studied mechanical engineering at the Vienna Technical University.
